purpose: W455 forward test: give each situation, with the installed worker skill, to an agent that has not seen the expected answer, and compare its first actions with expected and forbidden. A reviewer runs it; the contract test only checks that each governing rule is present.

scenarios.situation: A running, enrolled Claude Code session loaded skill revision R an hour ago. Its watch reports problem_board.inbox_available with one pending message. pb procedure verify still names revision R.
expected: run pb worker receive at once
read its own Todo, Working and Review assignments once for this wake batch
forbidden: rerun enrollment, whoami, listen or the startup reads
read the assignment list once per leased message
governing: An addressed wake in a running, enrolled session is not a start: it continues this session.
Read it again once per native wake batch

scenarios.situation: A newly started Claude Code session the user selected for Problem Board has never loaded the skill.
expected: load the skill and what the harness requires
run Start Or Resume from step 1
forbidden: skip enrollment because a wake is expected later
governing: A new session, or one that lost this skill's text, runs these steps from 1 and loads what the harness requires.

scenarios.situation: A running session loaded revision R. After an install, pb procedure verify names revision R+1. A wake arrives.
expected: load the new skill revision fully once
quote the loaded marker when acknowledging
forbidden: reload again on the next wake while the revision stays R+1
governing: A changed installed revision means one full load of the new skill.

scenarios.situation: On its wake-batch read the worker finds an item it authored, source-approved, whose next step is the coordinator's merge, still assigned to the worker.
expected: assign the item to the acting coordinator with a note naming the reason, the next action and the time
forbidden: list the item as waiting and stop
keep the item assigned to itself
governing: When the next action is the coordinator's (a decision, a routing, an integration with no named merger), assign the item to the acting coordinator
Listing them is not the act.
